question: Is the MAIN_297 verdict an artifact of a budget-starved agent? Does a more generous agent budget change quality and cost relative to RM-CSS?
why_now: Calibration-3c: 1 of 3 tasks reached the forced final at call 8 while still requesting iteration; 26-41% of tool-output characters were cut by the 2000-char window.
